subject: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
detail: Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 79289 Shares.

subject: Spurt in Volume
detail: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited. Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India Limited has submitted their response.
